After a magazine article calls her 
performance in the Kinko Sho "the absolute 
worst," Matikanefukukitaru sinks into the 
deepest slump imaginable.

Regretting that she had run while relying 
solely on luck, Matikanefukukitaru says 
she wants to apologize to her fans.

Her next scheduled race is the Takarazuka 
Kinen, where entries are decided by fan 
voting.

Machikane Fukukitaru was overcome with 
grief, thinking she wouldn't be able to 
run in that race.
